newsitem.title: THAILAND: TelecomAsia unit sells stake in phone firm.
newsitem.headline: TelecomAsia unit sells stake in phone firm.

text.p: Thailand's TelecomAsia Plc said on Thursday its wholly-owned unit, Telecom Holding Co Ltd, had sold off its 10 percent stake in Philippines-based Bayan Telecommunications Co Ltd to two investors.

TelecomAsia said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that Nynex Network System Co Ltd will purchase a 5.01 percent stake of Bayan Telecommunication from Telecom Holding, while AIF Telecommunications Fund will take a 4.99 percent stake.
Telecom Holding will get 925 million baht ($37 million) from the share sales, TelecomAsia said.

Bayan Telecommunication is a shareholder of International Communications Corp, which is installing and operating 300,000 fixed telephone lines and an international gateway in Manila and Luzon Island of the Philippines, it said.
Nynex Network System, a unit of Nynex Corp, is a major shareholder in TelecomAsia with an 18.19 percent stake.
